reader.requirement: At --std 85, a relative file with ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC must allow both sequential retrieval (format 1 READ, which must write NEXT, START, sequential REWRITE/DELETE) and random retrieval (format 2 READ by the relative key, random WRITE, REWRITE and DELETE) on one open, the sequential reads continuing from the position the random statements set.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 a dynamic READ that writes AT END / NOT AT END without NEXT is refused (COBOL7144, §1985:VIII.4.5.3 SR3); 2002+ implies NEXT
DialectBehavior.RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError: an out-of-range random/dynamic WRITE key is '24' below 2014, '34' from 2014

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectLevel|DialectBehavior|Year over KeyedIoBinder.cs, KeyedIoEmitter.cs, RelativeConnector.cs, KeyedConnector.cs, FileRegistry.cs; the access-mode branch itself (KeyedIoBinder.BindRead's kind switch, RelativeConnector's Access tests) is edition-free.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a sequential READ of a dynamic file must write NEXT (2002+ implies it from AT END), READ PREVIOUS is refused, and an out-of-range write key is status 24 (34 at 2023); the access-mode dispatch is the same code at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness exercises random READ and READ NEXT on a dynamic relative file; it does not exercise START, REWRITE, DELETE or WRITE in I-O mode under dynamic access, variable-length records, or the 1985 NEXT requirement

probes.expected: random WRITE/READ/REWRITE/DELETE and START + READ NEXT on one dynamic open (ODO record, RECORD VARYING DEPENDING ON), READ NEXT continuing after the random READ (§1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR4d), duplicate write 22, missing delete 23: matches

probes.printed: error COBOL7144: READ of relative file 'RFL' (ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC) retrieves sequentially but specifies no NEXT phrase (§1985:VIII.4.5.3 SR3 ...)
probes.expected: refused at 85 (SR3); at --std 2023 the same source compiles (EXIT 0), SR9 implies NEXT

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: READ PREVIOUS requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: refused: the 1985 format 1 READ has only NEXT

probes.printed: error COBOL1720: the AT END / NEXT phrase shall not be specified for a READ ... ACCESS MODE RANDOM
probes.expected: refused: random access takes format 2 only (§1985:VIII.4.5.3 SR2, SR4)

python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:VIII.4.5.3 SR3" "The NEXT phrase must be specified for files in dynamic access mode" -> OK  §1985:VIII.4.5.3 SR3  (4.5.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3

python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR15" "sets the file position indicator to the value contained in the data item referenced by the RELATIVE KEY phrase" -> OK  §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR15  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR15

reader.notes: Dynamic access is one runtime connector whose every branch is drawn on the access mode; at 85 the binder adds the 1985-only NEXT requirement and the edition gate on PREVIOUS. All probe lines match the 1985 text.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-130/src/dyn2.cob (--std 85, USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR declarative): format 2 READ with no phrase read by key (A1 00 RR05 005); random WRITE of 6 then READ NEXT after the READ of 5 gives 6 (A3 00 RR06 006: FPI unaffected by WRITE, §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR5); DELETE by key of 6 then READ NEXT gives 8 (A5: §1985:VIII.4.3.4 GR6); unsuccessful random READ (23) then READ NEXT gives 46 (A7: §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR12); REWRITE by key with no prior READ 00; START = 9 invalid (23) then READ NEXT 46; START = 2 then NEXT gives 2; at end 10 then NEXT 46; random READ 2 then NEXT gives 5. dyn14c.cob: dynamic READ NEXT onto RRN 12 with a PIC 9 key gives 14 then 46 (same at 2023); PIC 9(18) key 999999999999999999 gives 23. ext_dyn.cob / ext_rnd.cob: OPEN EXTEND on a DYNAMIC or RANDOM relative file refused COBOL2372 (§1985:VIII.4.4.3 SR1). Class c: st_lt (START LESS THAN), st_first (START FIRST), rd_lock/rd_nolock (lock phrases) refused COBOL0900; rd_key (READ KEY on relative) refused COBOL0864; START KEY IS >= compiles, correct since the amended 1985 relative START format lists 'IS >=' (spec line 18190). cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.4.3 SR1; OK §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR12; OK §1985:VIII.4.3.4 GR6; OK §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR5; OK §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR13.
